ragEvidence.participantReportedResult: Local retrieval through Qdrant and /api/ai/ask succeeded after raising AI_CONTEXT_LIMIT from 1 to 5.

evidenceBoundaries: All three public cards and their intended owner-statement labels were independently observed.
The GitHub commit proves the configuration change, not the participant-reported local retrieval result.
MyZubster does not automatically certify the cards' claims, linked sources, ownership or competence.
Professional experience, licences and qualifications on the transport card remain participant-declared; no private supporting documents were accessed.
The chunking commit proves the code change, not the participant-reported syntax-check result, re-ingestion execution or Qdrant document counts.
The visual graph implementation and READY deployment were independently verified, but participant navigation and rendered N4K48 nodes were not verified because Vercel authentication blocked access.
No email, merge, publication, transaction or GitHub write was performed on Nicola's behalf.
